title: Large loss notification: facts as stated in the sources (no calculations)

treaty_reference.description: Treaty / contract name or reference as stated

event_name.description: Catastrophe event or loss name, if any

date_of_loss.description: YYYY-MM-DD; for an event spanning several days the first day (explain in notes)

gross_loss.description: The cedent's current 100% gross loss estimate

previous_estimate.description: The previous 100% gross estimate, if this is an update and it is stated

cash_call.description: Amount requested from us, if this is a cash call

cash_call_due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, if a cash call states a due date

our_share.description: Our share / participation, only if the sources state it

as_written.description: Only the percentage, exactly as written, e.g. '7.5%'

source.description: Text file it was read from, relative to the job folder

sources.description: For every non-null field above except the amounts and our_share: where it was found

file.description: Text file, relative to the job folder

quote.description: Short verbatim quote from that file (no ellipses)

notes.description: Anything ambiguous, contradictory or missing that a reviewer should know

value.description: The stated amount written out in full: 'EUR 12.5m' -> 12500000. Never a sum, share or conversion

as_written.description: Only the amount, exactly as written in the source file, e.g. 'EUR 12.5m': no other words or numbers

source.description: Text file it was read from (body.txt or an attachment's .txt/.csv version), relative to the job folder
